event_reference.actual_behavior: ammo decrement and fired_shot first; empty ammo immediately tries ammo pack or pistol fallback, emits ammo_repacked/ammo_empty and sets shot_cd to reload_s; no separate reload state
event_reference.adoption: main author supplies historical weapon/event data, may opt into reload_contact only when there is a matching historical equipment event; no reload inferred from live ammo during replay

phase_contract: Read authored animation length from imported resource; fire is 0.233333s, not nominal 0.24s. Replay/pause/2x use historical normalized phase. Rapid shots may require event-scaled sampling or interruptible pulses; must not impose animation duration as shot cooldown.
transitions: Authored raise/lower and fire/reload endpoints align to ready/aim phase0. Arbitrary midclip cancellation, rapid repeated shots, weapon swaps and upper-body locomotion masks remain runtime acceptance by main author.
